description: Reviews local Python naming, readability, documentation, formatting, and cohesion while delegating architecture, testing, typing, and resilience. Project-agnostic; host-specific governance is optional.
user_intent_examples: Review this Python module for local readability and maintainability without changing its architecture.
when_to_load: When local naming, readability, documentation, function clarity, or class cohesion is central.
when_not_to_load: Do not load as architecture, refactoring, testing, typing, security, or resilience authority.
